issues.title: [Catalog Suggestion] PeaceCraft III — Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne
issues.review: No reply since Oct 26. Needs clean-room process clarification: decompiler/disassembly analysis versus separately authored behavioral implementation. Do not accept without resolving provenance.

last_human_comment.body:
Very cool project, thanks for submitting this! I have one question however. Remade focuses on independently authored, clean-room reimplementations. You describe the project as independently developed, but a cursory review of the repository’s RE notes suggests that decompilation was performed and the original binaries were analyzed.

Could you clarify how that analysis informed the implementation? Was any code directly translated from decompiler output, or was implementation carried out separately using chinese wall-style behavioral specifications, with an information barrier between analysis and implementation? I’d like to understand the development process before deciding on the listing.
last_human_comment.author: PixelSoftwareStudios
